Karnataka transporters question E20 petrol compatibility and test results

Transporters in Karnataka are seeking clarification regarding the test results of E20 petrol and its compatibility with vehicles. The controversy involves questions about the actual ethanol content in E20 petrol, with Bharat Petroleum reportedly adding to the discussion.
